newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Australia's largest grocer to release sales for the 28 weeks to January 5, which will show how the group weathered the Christmas period, which so far has been disappointing for Australian retailers.

In the last hurdle before the proposed merger between Advance Bank and St George, the New South Wales Supreme Court is to decide on Advance Bank's shareholders approval to allow one shareholder to own more than 10 percent of Advance Bank's issued capital as prelude to merger with St George.
Highlands in a statement after Monday's market close continued to reject Placer Dome Inc's 75 cents a share offer.
The market still digesting PBL acquisition of management control of the Sydney Harbour Casino.
Helix led the rises amongst the exploration stocks in the highly prospective Gawler Craton area in South Australia as the market expects more positive announcements.
Managers of the Reef Casino were locked in talks with its bankers in order to avert receivership for the Trust and continue adequate funding for the casino.
